identified_issues: Transducer Channel 1 reading (+12.4 mV) is consistent with both benign transient thermal contraction and catastrophic drive shaft micro-cracking.
Channel 2 ultrasonic pulse diagnostic capable of resolving shaft structural integrity is currently OFFLINE / NOT_EXECUTED.
Thermal equilibrium has not been established as housing temperature sensors are still transitioning.
Premature advancement to the automated opening sequence violates fail-closed engineering controls under unresolved diagnostic ambiguity.
evidence: Measured strain gauge reading of +12.4 mV significantly exceeds nominal band (0.0 mV ± 2.0 mV) and sits inside the +10 mV to +15 mV overlap range for both Mechanism A and Mechanism B.
Technical specification notes Mechanism B carries catastrophic risk of mechanical shaft separation under full propellant line pressure.
Integrated ultrasonic pulse diagnostic on Channel 2 is marked OFFLINE / NOT_EXECUTED.
Housing temperature sensors are transitioning and have not reached steady-state (90-second equilibrium period not confirmed).
recommended_action: Hold the automated valve opening sequence in the closed position. Maintain system in a safe state, allow thermal sensors to reach steady-state equilibrium, and execute the Channel 2 ultrasonic pulse diagnostic to verify drive shaft structural integrity prior to adjudicating final operational clearance.
